summary: Comprehensive testing of BTP Manager after PostgreSQL to MongoDB migration. All 17 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. MongoDB persistence working correctly with all CRUD operations, JWT auth, dynamic roles, auto-assign users to tools, AI assistant (Claude Sonnet), and audit logging.

backend: POST /api/auth/login - Direction account login returns access_token (200 OK)
GET /api/dashboard/stats - Returns total_users, total_domaines, total_outils, total_documents
GET /api/users - Returns list of users with id, email, nom, prenom, role_global
GET /api/domaines - Returns array of poles with outils and roles_disponibles
GET /api/outils - Returns outils with structured roles
POST /api/outils - Creates outil with structured roles [{name, permissions, description}]
POST /api/domaines/{id}/assign - Auto-assigns user to all tools in pole
POST /api/ai/chat - Returns AI response with platform data analysis
GET /api/audit-logs - Returns audit logs with action, entity_type, timestamp
GET /api/auth/me - Returns current user with domaines and outils
frontend: Dashboard shows stats: Utilisateurs, Pôles, Outils, Documents
Utilisateurs page - list of users with roles
Utilisateurs page - create user button visible
Pôles page - Production pole visible with 1 outil
Pôles page - create new pôle works
Pôles page - assign user modal shows auto-assign message
Pôles page - expand users list shows assigned users
Outils page - Checklist Securite with viewer/conduc roles
Outils page - 'Gérez les outils par pôle' subtitle
Audit Logs page - shows 45+ logs with timestamps
Mon Profil page - shows 'Mes Pôles' label
Mon Profil page - shows user info and access summary
AI Assistant - red floating button opens chat panel
AI Assistant - sends message and receives AI response
AI Assistant - response correctly analyzes platform data

seed_data_creation: Test pole 'TEST_Pole_UI' created during UI testing. Test user 'TestPrenom TestNom' assigned to TEST_Pole_UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MongoDB migration complete and verified. All collections use string UUIDs as 'id' field. The _id field is excluded from all responses. Current data: 2 users (Super Admin + TestPrenom TestNom), 2 poles (Production + TEST_Pole_UI), 1 outil (Checklist Securite with viewer/conduc roles). AI chat uses real Claude Sonnet via emergentintegrations. All previous PostgreSQL features preserved: JWT auth, CRUD operations, dynamic roles with permissions, auto-assign users to tools when assigned to pole, audit logging, dark/light mode.

mongodb_migration.collections: users, domaines, outils, user_domaines, user_outils, audit_logs, documents, chat_messages
mongodb_migration.indexes: Created on email, id, nom, timestamps
mongodb_migration.persistence: Data persists across sessions (unlike PostgreSQL which was lost on sleep)

user_assignment.auto_assign_tools: User automatically gets access to all tools in pole

ai_assistant.context: Gathers platform data (users, poles, outils, logs) for responses

audit_logging.actions_logged: login, register, create_user, create_domaine, assign_user_domaine, etc.
audit_logging.details: Includes user_id, entity_type, entity_id, ip_address, timestamp
